Abyssal Cartographers chart what most people refuse to admit exists: drowned tunnels, pressure-cut caverns, forgotten ferry lines, and the strange geometry of places where water remembers older routes than roads do. They do not merely travel hidden ways. They prove those ways were always there.

Crew Type (BBTTCC): Ashbound Survivors.

“You don’t conquer the wasteland. You outlast it.”

Ashbound Survivors know how to live where maps stop pretending. They ration breath, read heat shimmer like scripture, and treat hostile terrain as a negotiation instead of a death sentence.

  • Tactical Identity: You gain proficiency in Survival and Nature.
  • Strategic Identity: Your faction starts with +1 Economy OPs.

Tier 1 — Ashbound Survivors

You’ve learned the first mercy of dead land: preparation beats optimism.

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Survival and Nature.
  • Strategic: In Desert, Ash Wastes, and Wasteland hexes, environmental travel penalties are reduced and hazard pressure is easier to withstand.

Tier 2 — Ashbound Survivors

You’ve stopped fearing hardship and started budgeting it.

  • Strategic: When your faction survives or resolves hazard encounters in Desert, Ash Wastes, or Wasteland terrain, it can convert that hardship into useful recovery, salvage, or logistical gain.

Tier 3 — Ashbound Survivors

You’ve learned to make the bad route pay for itself.

  • Tactical: You have advantage on checks made to endure environmental strain, locate shelter, scavenge sustenance, or navigate by ruin-sign, stars, or ashfall.
  • Strategic: Failed or costly travel through harsh terrain is less likely to become pure loss; wasteland movement can generate trace gain, salvage, or reduced attrition instead.

Tier 4 — Ashbound Survivors

The wasteland is no longer a penalty. It is infrastructure with bad manners.

  • Strategic: Controlled Desert, Ash Wastes, and Wasteland hexes become far more livable and productive for your faction. Harsh terrain drains less, supports movement more reliably, and can produce meaningful recovery or economic value over time.
